from pyspark.sql import functions as F

bronze_path = (
    "abfss://bronze@stnvdaanna2026.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "stock/batch/"
)

df_bronze = (
    spark.read
    .option("header", "true")
    .option("inferSchema", "true")
    .csv(bronze_path)
)

print("Bronze rows:", df_bronze.count())
df_bronze.printSchema()
df_bronze.show(5, truncate=False)

df_silver = (
    df_bronze

    # Original Silver dataset doesn't use adjusted close
    .drop("Adj Close")

    # Normalize Date
    .withColumn(
        "Date",
        F.date_format(F.to_date("Date"), "yyyy-MM-dd")
    )

    # Remove invalid records
    .filter(F.col("Date").isNotNull())
    .filter(F.col("Volume").isNotNull())

    # Remove duplicate trading dates
    .dropDuplicates(["Date"])

    # Stable Silver schema
    .select(
        "Date",
        "Close",
        "High",
        "Low",
        "Open",
        "Volume"
    )

    # Deterministic order for inspection
    .orderBy("Date")
)

df_silver.printSchema()
df_silver.show(10, truncate=False)

print("Silver rows:", df_silver.count())

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

dq = df_silver.agg(
    F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
    F.countDistinct("Date").alias("unique_dates"),
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("Close").isNull(), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("null_close"),
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("Volume").isNull(), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("null_volume"),
    F.min("Date").alias("min_date"),
    F.max("Date").alias("max_date")
)

dq.show(truncate=False)

silver_path = (
    "abfss://silver@stnvdaanna2026.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "stock/"
)

(
    df_silver
    .write
    .mode("overwrite")
    .parquet(silver_path)
)

print("Stock Silver write completed.")

silver_check = spark.read.parquet(silver_path)

print("Silver persisted rows:", silver_check.count())
silver_check.printSchema()
silver_check.show(5, truncate=False)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
stocks_check = spark.read.parquet(
    "abfss://silver@stnvdaanna2026.dfs.core.windows.net/stock/"
)

stocks_check.agg(
    F.count("*").alias("rows"),
    F.countDistinct("Date").alias("unique_dates"),
    F.min("Date").alias("min_date"),
    F.max("Date").alias("max_date")
).show()
